description: MiniMax multimodal API platform, including asynchronous video generation and file retrieval.
residency_notes: MiniMax's current API privacy policy says personal data is stored in data centers in the United States. The platform also distinguishes mainland-China and overseas/global service regions, but the public API materials do not provide a general Zero Data Retention control or a model execution-location guarantee.
prompt_training_notes: MiniMax's Open Platform Terms say MiniMax may use input and generated content to provide, maintain, develop, and improve its services. The public API policy does not provide a general no-training or zero-retention guarantee.

verification.notes: Verified against MiniMax's current API overview, V1/V2 video generation, query, file retrieval, pricing, and error references.
